subject: The secret 100+ professionals discovered about meetings today
preview_text: They all did one thing in Smart Notes this morning. Here's what happened (and why you should care).
body_paragraphs: I just checked the dashboard and saw something wild. Over 100 professionals used the same exact feature in Smart Notes this morning before their 9 AM meetings. And by 10 AM, their teams were already acting on decisions that would have normally taken days.

These weren't power users. They were people like you who downloaded the app, maybe opened it once, and then let it sit. But this morning, they all decided to try the real-time transcription for just one meeting. The result? Zero follow-up emails clarifying action items. Zero 'what did we decide?' messages. Just pure, documented momentum. One project manager told me her team moved a deadline up by two weeks because nothing got lost in translation.

The magic isn't in the AI (though it's brilliant). It's in the 'Share Summary' button. The moment your meeting ends, you tap it. A clean, organized summary—decisions, next steps, owners—hits your team's inbox before they've even stood up from their chairs. You stop being a note-taker and start being the person who makes things happen.

Your next meeting is your chance. Open Smart Notes, hit record, and just listen. Then be the one who shares the single source of truth. It takes less effort than brewing a pot of coffee. P.S. The most organized person in your next meeting won't be the one with the notebook. It'll be the one who sends the summary 30 seconds after saying goodbye.
